purpose: Inspect native opening rules, without querying individual virtual accounts or balances.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native opening-rule identity; retained as a string.

fields.name: businessCategory
fields.meaning: Native business-line selection; may be null.

fields.name: customerTags
fields.meaning: Native customer-group text; commas are literal.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Native currency text; commas are literal.

identity_description: Nonblank native string id; no numeric conversion or synthetic identity.
limitations: One zero-based JSON request with pageSize=1000; native total must match unique acquired rows. This is a verified width, not a maximum-capacity claim.
Native totalPageNo is a placeholder and does not establish completeness.
All filters are local exact matches: repeated values OR, different fields AND; commas and * are literal.
Opening-rule configurations are not individual virtual accounts, balances, capacity or bank-account VA rules.
Native nested/unknown fields remain unchanged; timestamps retain native values without unit/timezone conversion.
